blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY, Pampanga — Police arrested four men and confiscated P879,000 worth of petroleum products in an operation against unauthorized sale and distribution of fuel in Magalang, Pampanga on Oct. 9. The Police Regional Office 3 (PRO3) said the Regional Special Operations Group of the Regional Intelligence Division 3 conducted the operation in coordination with the Pampanga and Magalang police offices at a gasoline station along Ninoy Aquino Road at 3 p.m. Police arrested the station’s cashier and three pump attendants, who were allegedly caught selling petroleum products without the necessary regulatory authorization from the Department of Energy.
